Here is a highly precise and detailed prompt designed for text-to-image generators (like Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or DALL-E 3) to replicate the exact pose, body shape, composition, and style of the image without any watermarks or bokeh:

### **Detailed Image Generation Prompt**

> **Subject & Body Shape:** A candid amateur photo of a blonde woman with an extreme hourglass, pear-shaped figure. She has a slender waist, very wide hips, and exceptionally large, voluptuous, perfectly round, and smooth buttocks that dominate the lower center of the frame. 
>
> **Pose & Clothing:** She is positioned with her back directly to the camera, bending forward slightly at the waist and looking back over her left shoulder towards the viewer with a playful, casual smile. She is wearing dark sunglasses and a dark gray t-shirt. Her blue pants are pulled down around her mid-thighs, exposing her rear. She is wearing a thin, light-blue g-string thong.
>
> **Lighting & Special Effects:** A bright, golden sunset is positioned directly on the horizon in the background. The intense sun creates a vibrant, circular golden lens flare reflection directly onto her left buttock, illuminating the skin with a warm, glowing circular highlight. 
>
> **Camera Angle & Composition:** Eye-level wide-angle shot, taken from directly behind the subject. The camera is close to the subject, making her lower body the central focus while keeping the entire landscape in sharp, clear focus from foreground to background.
>
> **Setting & Background:** The woman is standing on a grassy, brush-covered hill overlooking a vast, sprawling city valley below. The sky is a clear gradient, transitioning from bright golden-orange near the horizon to a deep blue overhead.
>
> **Style & Quality:** Candid amateur mobile phone photography style, realistic skin texture, natural warm lighting, deep depth of field, sharp focus throughout, no bokeh, no blur, high-resolution, clean image with no watermarks, no text, no logos.
